hypotheses.construction_plan: Evaluate the same product template V(theta)*G0(theta)*V(theta) at theta=p and theta=q, then sum the two specializations.
required_assumptions: V and G0 are unary functions of the parameter theta.
Multiplication is associative and commutative, allowing the two V factors to be grouped as in the AC observation.
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands are non-identical only through the free symbol p or q; they match a single symbolic product template under specialization. This explains the observed F01 AC-equivalent family without postulating hidden operations.
